title: Hand Starvation and Zombie Pinning in SIEVE: A Comparative Atlas of Unbounded Belady Anomalies in Modern Cache Policies
description: Research artifact proving and cross-verifying an unbounded Belady anomaly (hand starvation / zombie pinning) in the SIEVE cache eviction algorithm (0% steady-state miss rate at capacity k vs. 100% at capacity C for all 3 <= k < C), establishing a sharp k=2 phase transition and structural separation against FIFO, CLOCK, 2-bit CLOCK, SecondChance, and S3-FIFO (including periodic multiple-of-10 S3-FIFO boundary spikes), audited 1:1 against 1a1a11a/libCacheSim commit 4b66d97, and evaluating O(1) zero-per-node-overhead mitigations SIEVE-TP and SIEVE-BW across Python and Go simulators.
